create_rloo_config: create an RLOOConfig instance for configuring RLOO trainer with custom training parameters
build_rloo_trainer_cli: build command-line arguments from RLOOConfig using HfArgumentParser for argparse-based CLI usage
configure_vllm_generation: configure RLOOConfig to use vLLM for accelerated generation with colocated or server mode
validate_generation_batch: validate that generation_batch_size and steps_per_generation are mutually exclusive and divisible by global batch size
validate_num_generations: validate that num_generations is at least 2 since RLOO requires multiple generations per prompt for advantage calculation
